description: This file contains JavaScript code for rendering and managing interactive timeline visualizations in a web UI, specifically for application, job, and task timelines in Apache Spark's web UI. It defines functions for drawing timelines, handling user interactions, and configuring timeline options.

methods.name: drawApplicationTimeline
methods.description: Creates and manages the application timeline visualization, including event handling for job entries and expand/collapse UI controls.

methods.name: drawJobTimeline
methods.description: Creates and manages the job timeline visualization, including stage entry interactions and expand/collapse controls.

methods.name: drawTaskAssignmentTimeline
methods.description: Creates and manages the task assignment timeline visualization, including tooltip handling and expand/collapse controls.

methods.name: setupExecutorEventAction
methods.description: Sets up hover interactions for executor event items to show/hide tooltips.

methods.name: setupZoomable
methods.description: Configures zoom toggle behavior for timeline visualizations based on checkbox input.
